facts.text: The current CCMC opinion covers Adex EIFS used as exterior wall cladding designed to act as a weather barrier and provide thermal insulation, under stated conditions and limitations.
The opinion classifies NBC 2020 Article 3.1.5.5, Combustible Cladding on Exterior Walls, as Acceptable.
